posting.title: GTM Enablement Partner (APAC)
posting.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

We are hiring a GTM Enablement Manager to support our EMEA region as our first dedicated enablement hire on the ground. This is a net new role sitting within the broader global GTM Enablement team. Reporting to the GTM Enablement Lead, this person will support the enablement function regionally — including onboarding and training for EMEA reps, localizing content for the region, driving regional GTM programs, and managing stakeholder and field communications. The ideal candidate will work closely with NAMER-based enablement partners to ensure global consistency and contribute to global rollouts. They must be highly collaborative, comfortable working across time zones, and able to operate with autonomy while staying tightly aligned with the global team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Training & Support: Lead local onboarding sessions and create essential training materials that empower EMEA GTM teams with knowledge and skills.

  • Content Localization: Partner with global enablement and internal teams to adapt and localize GTM collateral and enablement resources for the EMEA market.

  • Regional GTM Programs: Drive regional enablement programs and field communications that support EMEA revenue goals and rep effectiveness.

  • Global Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with NAMER-based enablement partners to ensure consistency across global rollouts and integrate product knowledge and sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC) into training.

  • Foundational Enablement: Develop and centralize enablement content, tools, and resources for the EMEA GTM org.

Qualifications

  • 6-8 years of experience in related fields, with at least 4 years in enablement or training roles, or customer facing work. Preferable to sales backgrounds.

  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, with an adaptable, collaborative approach.

  • Experience with training design, curriculum creation, and a "roll up your sleeves" mentality.

  • Familiarity with GTM

Role Overview

As an Associate Legal Engineer, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring our law firm and in-house customer users are set up for success. You will deliver tailored training, create education strategies that align with legal workflows, and serve as a trusted guide to customers adopting Harvey across practice groups and legal departments.

Your legal training and experience will allow you to connect deeply with our users, helping them to translate their own legal acumen into productive and innovative use of Harvey’s platform. You’ll work across a diverse range of clients, primarily mid-market and enterprise customers, and partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Product.

This is a high-impact, customer-facing role ideal for someone with a few years of legal practice experience and a passion for shaping the future of legal work.

What You'll Do

  • Deliver engaging and customized product training to attorneys at leading law firms and corporate legal departments

  • Partner with Account Executives and Customer Success Managers and more senior Legal Engineers to understand client goals to design and deliver enablement sessions that maximize value

  • Support onboarding, expansion, and renewal efforts by ensuring users are confident and proficient with the platform

  • Gather feedback from training sessions and pass insights to Product and Engineering teams to inform development

  • Build scalable training content, including documentation, videos, and quick reference guides tailored to practice areas

  • Evangelize Harvey internally and externally as a leader in AI-powered legal technology

What You Have

  • A J.D. and typically 1–3 years of relevant practical experience in legal practice, legal technology or a related role.
